items.titleZh: 墨西哥站无进一步调查：审查后常识使然
items.summaryZh: 加斯利因在维修区出口红灯时离开而被指出，但他在维修区末端加速离开阿尔派车队的维修区时，反应时间非常紧张。
items.originalTitle: Common sense here as no further investigation after a review #F1 #MexicoGP
items.summaryEn: Common sense here as no further investigation after a review #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Gasly noted for leaving the pit exit on a red light, but that looks so hard to react to in time as he accelerated out of the Alpine pit box at that end of the pit lane #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 常识在这里，因为经过审查后没有进一步的调查 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛Chris Medland：加斯利因在红灯时离开维修区出口而受到关注，但他在维修区末端从阿尔卑斯车队维修区加速出来时，看起来很难及时做出反应 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn: Common sense here as no further investigation after a review #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Gasly noted for leaving the pit exit on a red light, but that looks so hard to react to in time as he accelerated out of the Alpine pit box at that end of the pit lane #F1 #MexicoGP
